description: Connect your Google account and choose which Invo Plus businesses your assistant can access. Browse products and customers, read date-filtered orders and business notifications with pagination, create products, update fixed prices with version checks, and prepare structured or sandboxed single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript website pages as drafts. Order, activity and custom-code access require separate consent. Publish pages when explicitly requested. New users can register a business workspace from a description without starting a subscription. Access follows your business role, approved permissions and feature entitlements. Customer emails are omitted unless requested. Hidden products and draft pages remain publicly readable in existing storefront storage, so use public product and website copy only. You can revoke the connection from the connection-management page.

defaultPrompt: Show my businesses, select one, and summarize its orders and recorded activity for the last seven days.
Create a draft page with single-file HTML and CSS, then add a section while preserving the existing content.
Help me set up a new business workspace from my description.
